description: Calculate pay from approved time; fund direct deposit and pay cards; withhold taxes; pay about 3,600 associates every Friday
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.45 million to about 3,600 associates every Friday; payroll is processed Wednesday and funded Thursday, so 48 hours from the Wednesday cutoff is the outer limit; overtime earned in a workweek must be paid on the regular payday (29 CFR 778.106); bank changes and time edits made in the last hours are hard to recreate
manual_workaround: Off-cycle manual payroll from the prior week's register with adjustments (procedure not yet written, POAM-011); pay card funding through the vendor's support line
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-04 integration platform; SYS-14
dependent_third_parties: Payroll vendor; payroll vendor's bank; credit line lender
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Payroll and Billing; 16 payroll specialists; Controller; HQ
quantified_operational_impact: 3,600 associates unpaid; about 5% (180) would leave their assignments within a week, at about $500 each to refill ($90,000), plus about $35,000 in off-cycle vendor fees, pay card funding, and overtime
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late overtime pay (29 CFR 778.106); wage complaints from associates

description: Associates clock in on the mobile app or a fingerprint clock; client supervisors approve time in the client portal or the VMS by Monday 12:00
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cannot run without approved time; clients approve by Monday 12:00 for Wednesday processing; punches captured in the last 4 hours are hard to reconstruct
manual_workaround: Paper timesheets signed by client supervisors; paper sign-in sheets at on-site programs; clocks hold punches locally until reconnected; VMS time imported by file
dependent_systems: SYS-06; SYS-01 client portal; SYS-11; SYS-04 integration platform
dependent_third_parties: Timekeeping vendor; ATS vendor; VMS vendor; clients
dependent_people_or_facilities: Payroll specialists; on-site coordinators; Branch Office Administrators
quantified_operational_impact: About 3,600 timesheets a week; paper collection and keying takes about 900 extra staff hours a week

business_process: Associate onboarding (Form I-9, E-Verify, background checks, drug screens, tax and bank forms)
description: Complete Form I-9 Sections 1 and 2, create the E-Verify case, order the consumer report and drug screen, collect W-4 and direct deposit forms
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Form I-9 Section 2 and the E-Verify case are due within 3 business days of hire (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ii); MOU Art. II.A.7; Fla. Stat. 448.095(2)(a)); about 55 new hires a business day cannot start without onboarding
manual_workaround: Paper Form I-9 packets at each branch; E-Verify website used directly; screening provider portal used directly; record E-Verify outages with daily screenshots (Fla. Stat. 448.095(2)(c))
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; DHS E-Verify; screening provider; drug testing administrator
quantified_operational_impact: About 55 new starts per business day; each delayed start loses about $350 of gross margin per day (about $58,000 over 3 business days)
quantified_regulatory_impact: Late Section 2 or E-Verify cases across many hires are paperwork violations; the MOU timing rule is breached

description: Take job orders from about 900 branch clients and assign associates to next-day shifts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Branch units bill about $215,000 per business day; next-day shifts must be filled by early evening; clients move orders to competitors after missed shifts; associates must not be sent to closed or unsafe sites
manual_workaround: Phone and spreadsheet dispatch from the daily assignment export in the file share; branch phone trees
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; contact center platform vendor; phone carriers
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,600 branch associates dispatched each day; a 24-hour outage leaves about 30% of next-day orders unfilled (about $65,000 of billings and $15,000 of gross margin) plus about $30,000 in client credits and premium pay to refill

business_process: Healthcare shift scheduling and credential verification
description: Confirm per diem and contract shifts at 38 health care clients; verify that each clinician's license, certifications, health clearances, and level 2 screening are current before the shift; send compliance files to clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Shifts run 7 days a week; a clinician may not start a shift unless credentials are verified and documented (Fla. Stat. 400.980(5)); hospital clients cancel orders and float their own staff after a missed shift
manual_workaround: Daily export of each scheduled clinician's credential status (license, BLS, TB test, immunizations, screening) to the HQ file share; license lookups on the state licensing website; shift confirmations by phone
dependent_third_parties: Credentialing vendor; ATS vendor; AHCA screening results; health care clients
dependent_people_or_facilities: Credentialing Manager; 11 credentialing specialists; 30 Healthcare recruiters; 6 clinical managers
quantified_operational_impact: About 420 clinicians on assignment and about 60 shift starts a day; 12 hours down puts about 30 shift starts at risk (about $17,000 of billings) plus client cancellation charges
quantified_regulatory_impact: A clinician working without verified credentials breaches Fla. Stat. 400.980(5) and the client agreement

description: Run the associate workforce inside 6 client distribution centers: shift attendance, fingerprint clock punches, headcount and fill-rate reports each shift
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 6 client distribution centers run around the clock with about 1,300 associates; clients require fill-rate and attendance reports each shift; the program contracts carry fill-rate credits
manual_workaround: Paper sign-in sheets verified by on-site coordinators; clocks store punches locally until reconnected; headcount from the last export
dependent_systems: SYS-06 clocks; SYS-01; SYS-13 on-site offices; SYS-14
dependent_third_parties: Timekeeping vendor; client distribution centers; SD-WAN provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,300 associates across 18 shifts a day; fill-rate credits of about $5,000 per program per day below 95%

description: Run the contingent workforce programs of 2 MSP clients in the VMS: requisitions, supplier submissions, supplier timesheets, and one consolidated weekly invoice per client
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The 2 MSP clients depend on the VMS for about 1,100 contingent workers from 65 suppliers; contracts commit VMS availability, 48-hour incident notice, and a SOC 2 Type 2 report; losing either client would end the program
manual_workaround: Requisitions by email from the client program contacts; supplier timesheets by spreadsheet; consolidated invoice delayed one cycle
dependent_systems: SYS-11; SYS-02; SYS-04 integration platform; SYS-03
dependent_third_parties: VMS vendor; 65 supplier staffing firms; MSP clients
quantified_operational_impact: Consolidated invoices of about $2.6 million a week across the 2 clients (mostly supplier pass-through); supplier pay delayed if invoices slip
quantified_regulatory_impact: Contract service-level credits; SOC 2 Availability commitments (P09)

business_process: Associate communications and recruiting contact center
description: Calls and texts to associates about shifts, closures, and pay; inbound recruiting calls (about 2,500 a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Associates must learn of site closures (for example, hurricanes) and shift changes before they travel
manual_workaround: Recruiters call and text from company smartphones using exported contact lists; carrier-hosted closure message on the main number
dependent_systems: SYS-12; SYS-01 texting; SYS-05; SYS-14 smartphones
dependent_third_parties: Contact center platform vendor; ATS vendor; carriers
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,500 calls a day go unanswered; associates miss shift changes

description: Post jobs, receive about 2,300 applications a week, AI ranking and text pre-screening, interviews, offers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A few days of delay slows fills but walk-in and phone applications can be taken on paper
manual_workaround: Paper applications at branches; job board inboxes; recruiter review without the AI tools
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; AI vendors; job boards
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,300 applications a week; fill time grows by about 2 days

description: Produce Forms I-9 and audit trails on 3 business days' notice; answer AHCA requests for screening and credential records; answer consumer report disputes; E-Verify case follow-up
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: An inspection notice gives at least 3 business days to produce Forms I-9 (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)(ii)); records must stay available and unaltered
manual_workaround: Ask the inspecting agency for an extension; produce ATS records first and archive records later
dependent_systems: SYS-01 I-9 module; SYS-04 document archive; SYS-10; SYS-04 backup account
dependent_third_parties: ATS vendor; cloud provider; credentialing vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Compliance and Privacy; compliance analysts
quantified_operational_impact: Compliance staff time; outside counsel support
quantified_regulatory_impact: Paperwork violations are assessed per form if forms or audit trails cannot be produced

description: Weekly invoices from approved time; ACH and check receipts; collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $1.9 million billed per week; invoices feed the credit line borrowing base; a week of delay strains cash but is recoverable
manual_workaround: Invoice from payroll register exports; delay one cycle and tell the lender
quantified_operational_impact: About $1.9 million of cash delayed per week, plus overtime and interest

description: Weekly borrowing base certificate and Thursday credit line draw that funds payroll; cash positioning
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll is funded each Thursday by a credit line draw; without the draw the payroll vendor cannot release funds
manual_workaround: Draw request by phone to the relationship manager with a manual borrowing base; CFO and Controller dual approval

description: Biweekly payroll for 600 internal staff; internal hiring and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The biweekly schedule allows a short delay
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the vendor
quantified_operational_impact: 600 staff paid late at most one day

business_process: Workers' compensation and safety incident reporting
description: Injury reports to the workers' compensation carrier; client site safety visits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Injury reports can be made by phone and paper for several days
manual_workaround: Carrier phone line; paper injury forms
dependent_people_or_facilities: Safety and Risk Manager; safety coordinators

description: Refer candidates to clients for permanent jobs for a fee
manual_workaround: Work from recruiter notes and job board inboxes
quantified_operational_impact: A week of delay on a few placements
